scope: All registered researchers using the single R&D LaTeX control tower; applies to student-facing source and PDF review, irrespective of document genre or whether first-person writing is allowed

separation_of_concerns.human_scientific_authority: researcher, supervisor and relevant university rules

rules.requirement: Write from the student's actual experience and research role; avoid framing the student as an external interview respondent when they are the author. First-person past tense is permitted only when supported by field records and institution/supervisor writing rules. Third person is correct for genuine outside authors/participants.
Never invent sites, participant responses, fieldwork, site diaries, interviews, sample sizes, times, costs, causal diagnoses, academic credentials, consent, approvals, or laboratory tests.

Distinguish photograph, direct observation, suspected defect, documented corrective event, verified physical cause, measured cost and critical-path delay. An image alone does not confirm a cause or rework quantity.

Use descriptive academic figure/table captions, not internal machine control IDs, A9 labels, ChatGPT/QA jargon or case codes. Keep stable photo IDs in private manifests and source graphic paths, not in typeset captions. Never remove legitimate published research identifiers.

Every researcher owns their objectives, admitted populations, cases, photos and conclusions. Scope exclusion is manuscript-specific; Safal's road-case exclusion must not automatically remove valid road research from other projects.

Citations must support their actual claims; removing a research topic requires removing its unneeded discussion/figures and unused bibliography entries without deleting unrelated evidence in the preserved previous version.
Do not misrepresent AI/writing assistance or conceal its use when disclosure is required. Student must review, correct and accept the manuscript content.

Preserve prior source/ref, advance source version and source commit, compile from exact approved candidate plus private deps, record PDF SHA and toolchain, upload to correct Drive folder and read back ID/parent before calling deliverable complete.

Typography/layout belongs in one .sty; semantic integrity in this JSON plus validator; student-specific cover content and spacing variants belong in project configuration. Generalized shared cover-gap helper is opt-in, not a forced 30pt global change.
Static linting, exact-font PDF compilation, whole-page visual QA, science review, full PU formatting acceptance, and A9 Local/Main acknowledgment are separate gates. No one gate implies another.

Submission-facing academic prose presents performed methods, admitted numerical/observational findings, and defensible interpretations. Do not place administrative evidence inventories, unavailable-record status matrices, source-admission flags, supervisor audit checklists, model-setup collection requests, AI-assisted work-process commentary, or repeatedly apologetic 'data were not provided' prose in results/discussion as if they were findings. Move those details to the owning researcher's governed Google Doc audit/QA records. Preserve an appropriately concise methodological limitation wherever its removal would mislead readers, mask a materially incomplete method, or imply missing analyses were performed. Explicitly avoid editor-facing phrases such as 'source workbook cached', 'data were unavailable', 'a file could not be verified', or 'not an independently regenerated model' in place of actual research findings; use technical descriptions of model assumptions and results. Preserve material scientific uncertainties and limitations in concise accurate scientific form instead of removing essential disclosures.

A research table must contain a meaningful comparison, actual admitted observations, verified quantities, or substantive literature information; repetitive 'Available / Not available / Same limitation' tables are not research results and belong in audit records. An objectives/results mapping intended solely for internal traceability also belongs in QA; student-facing discussion should synthesize the actual findings relevant to the objectives in natural, specific academic language without overstating causation, code acceptance, or scientific completeness. Preserve numerical values, references, relevant study limitations and author/supervisor review.

Do not insert ChatGPT, AI authorship diagnostics, hallucination warnings, unsupported-source complaints, dataset custody mechanisms, prompt/ledger/PR identifiers, automation summaries, or self-evaluation of the writing into a submitted thesis. Keep those in internal audit/control records. This is a manuscript relevance and clarity rule, not permission to conceal AI assistance where institutional disclosure is required; existing assistance-disclosure rule remains controlling.

All submitted representations are the researcher's complete thesis with formal academic prose. Never place ChatGPT/AI pipeline narration, conversion commentary, processing summaries, draft/review/candidate markers, file-availability complaints, evidence-custody or internal status prose in title pages, chapters, captions, footers, appendices, TOC, or native Google Doc. Hold internal checklists and status in owner-only audit and release records, not manuscript content. Proper institutional assistance disclosures are governed by actual university rules.

Keep each populated Google Workspace live ID and canonical Git source path. First archive next numbered PRE; edit only necessary manuscript source paragraphs/assets; compile PDF from preserved source tree; provider-readback and archive POST. Preserve previous figures, tables, analytical results, citations, theory and appendix material. Never rebuild a reduced manuscript or replace a stable Google Doc merely for a formatting correction. Derived PDF or ZIP may be versioned immutable snapshots while preserving a separately registered live artifact ID.

Working review/QC statuses may exist only as internal metadata and the audit Google Doc. Every created thesis representation must have actual full intended thesis content and academic-facing title/figures, without visible pending, review, draft, parity-hold, automation or machine process language. Missing elements fail internal release gates; never conceal scientific results or claim nonexistent analyses.

linter.scan: manuscript frontmatter abstracts, chapters and appendices
guardrails: Flag student-self third-person constructions for review, not automatic replacement
Flag uppercase administrative photo identifiers only where visible text is detectable
No repair or prose rewriting in validation code
False positives reviewed by manuscript owner; never blanket-forbid first/third person

Advisory: flag repeated administrative 'available/unavailable evidence' table cells, machine status language, and objectives-only traceability tables inside student-facing results; never remove scientific limitations without researcher review

permissions: Never upload private original photographs or licensed font binaries to public repository
institution_override: Applicable PU and supervisor directions on style, authorship and ethics take precedence

lineage.derived_from: RSH-010 v1.11 author-voice correction and v1.12 source/figure/cover-spacing work
lineage.generalized_from: Saugat Paneru CP114 M4.2 editorial audit separation, 2026-10-30; no scientific content inherited across researchers
